summary: Fresh StockCount Pro MVP tested end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass (stats, product CRUD, barcode lookup, quantity delta clamp, reorder with manual flag, locations CRUD with in-use guard, idempotent location create, 404s). Frontend: Home, Inventory (search, location chips, +/- steppers), Reorder list, Product form, and Locations screens all render and work correctly. Two frontend defects found: (1) CRITICAL – Scanner manual entry never shows the result bottom sheet in web preview because the bottom sheet is only rendered inside the camera-granted branch; (2) MINOR – creating a product via /product/new throws 'The action GO_BACK was not handled' toast when loaded directly (product still gets created in DB).

ui_bugs.issue: When camera permission is NOT granted (always true in Expo web preview), the ManualDialog closes and the known/unknown barcode result bottom sheet never appears. The sheet JSX (lines 141-199) and the lookup state (`current`, `notFound`, `loading`) exist only inside the main return block, while the no-permission early return (lines 80-98) only renders the dialog, not the sheet. Verified in-browser: clicking manual-submit with 8001234500011 (Latte Intero) returns Product 200 from /api/products/barcode/{code} but UI shows nothing; same for unknown barcodes – 'create-from-scan' button is never visible.

After Crea prodotto on /product/new loaded directly, toast 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator' appears. Product IS created in backend (verified via GET /api/products?q=TEST_UI), but user is left on the form with no navigation feedback. Replace router.back() with router.replace('/(tabs)/inventory') or router.canGoBack() check.

integration_issues.flow: Scanner -> known barcode -> quantity stepper bottom sheet
integration_issues.issue: Flow is broken on web preview because of the UI bug above. Backend barcode lookup works.

action_items: FIX scanner.tsx: lift the result bottom sheet (and the current/notFound/loading rendering) out of the camera-granted branch so it also renders when permission is denied (web). Alternatively render a shared overlay regardless of permission state. Required for manual-entry workflow to be usable on web.

FIX product/[id].tsx: on successful create/update, use router.replace('/(tabs)/inventory') (or check router.canGoBack()) instead of router.back() so direct-URL navigation does not emit the GO_BACK warning.
Nice-to-have: add testID='manual-barcode-input' alias or document testID='manual-code-input'; add testIDs on inventory +/- stepper buttons and inventory search input for easier automation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses `.dict()` (Pydantic v1 API). Harmless now but should migrate to `.model_dump()` for Pydantic v2.
GET /api/products uses regex on raw user input – consider escaping q to avoid regex injection errors on special chars.
stats and reorder scan the full products collection in Python; fine at this scale but should become aggregations if data grows.
scanner.tsx is >200 lines with duplicated ManualDialog mounts in both branches – only one rendering is reachable at a time but the duplication contributed to the bug above.
seed_data_creation: No persistent test data left. Pytest tests clean up all TEST_ prefixed products and locations. One TEST_UI_Product created during UI testing was deleted via API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid (12/12). After E1 fixes scanner bottom-sheet rendering under no-permission branch and the GO_BACK navigation on product create, re-run the Playwright flow: open /scanner -> tap 'Inserimento manuale' -> submit '8001234500011' -> expect bottom sheet with product name 'Latte Intero 1L' and testID='scan-next'; then submit 'NEWCODE_1234' -> expect 'Codice non trovato' with testID='create-from-scan'. Also validate that /product/new -> Crea prodotto routes back to inventory without warning.
rca_of_issue: scanner.tsx early-returns the no-permission view at lines 76-98. The lookup result bottom sheet (lines 141-199) and its triggering state exist only in the main (permission-granted) return (lines 100+). On Expo web, camera permission is never granted, so manual-entry submit updates state but the sheet is never mounted. Fix by rendering a shared sheet overlay (e.g. moving the sheet JSX outside the early return, or restructuring to a single return with conditional camera content).
